/* ProdLangMapper.getProdInfoList */ SELECT thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD , thp.PROD_CD , thp.PROD_NM , thp.PROD_CLASS_CD , (SELECT SF_GET_PROD_CLASSES('H', thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD, thp.PROD_CLASS_CD) FROM DUAL) AS PROD_CLASS_NM , thpi.PROD_INFO , thpi.PROD_EN_INFO , thpi.PROD_CN_INFO , thpi.PROD_JP_INFO FROM TB_HQ_PRODUCT thp , TB_HQ_PRODUCT_INFO thpi WHERE 1=1 AND thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD = thpi.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) AND thp.PROD_CD = thpi.PROD_CD (+)
AND thp.PROD_CD LIKE '%'||#{prodCd}||'%' --상품코드
AND thp.PROD_NM LIKE '%'||#{prodNm}||'%' --상품명
AND thp.PROD_CLASS_CD IN ( SELECT PROD_CLASS_CD FROM TB_HQ_PRODUCT_CLASS WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} START WITH PROD_CLASS_CD = #{prodClassCd} AND HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} CONNECT BY PRIOR PROD_CLASS_CD = P_PROD_CLASS_CD AND HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} )
AND thp.USE_YN = #{useYn} --사용여부
-- 선택한 상품브랜드가 없을 때('전체' 일때), 사용자 관리브랜드에 속한 정보만 조회 AND thp.HQ_BRAND_CD IN
#{item}
AND ( ( ((SELECT COUNT(HQ_BRAND_CD) FROM TB_WB_USER_BRAND WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) != 0) AND (thp.HQ_BRAND_CD IN (SELECT HQ_BRAND_CD FROM TB_WB_USER_BRAND WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})) ) OR ( ((SELECT COUNT(HQ_BRAND_CD) FROM TB_WB_USER_BRAND WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) = 0) AND 1=1 ) ) ORDER BY thp.PROD_CD ASC

/* ProdLangMapper.getProdPlatformList */ SELECT thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD , (SELECT HQ_BRAND_NM FROM TB_HQ_BRAND thb WHERE thb.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND thb.HQ_BRAND_CD = thp.HQ_BRAND_CD) AS HQ_BRAND_NM , thp.PROD_CD , thp.PROD_NM , thp.PROD_CLASS_CD , (SELECT SF_GET_PROD_CLASSES('H', thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD, thp.PROD_CLASS_CD) FROM DUAL) AS PROD_CLASS_NM , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP END AS PROD_KO_NM_DISP_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP, INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_KO_NM_DISP_2 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP END AS PROD_EN_NM_DISP_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP, INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_EN_NM_DISP_2 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP END AS PROD_CN_NM_DISP_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP, INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_CN_NM_DISP_2 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP END AS PROD_JP_NM_DISP_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP, INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_JP_NM_DISP_2 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK END AS PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK, INSTR(thpi.PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_KO_NM_DISP_KIOSK_2 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK END AS PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, INSTR(thpi.PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_EN_NM_DISP_KIOSK_2 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK END AS PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, INSTR(thpi.PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_CN_NM_DISP_KIOSK_2 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK, 1, INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) - 1) ELSE thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK END AS PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK_1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK, INSTR(thpi.PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK, CHR(10)) + 1) ELSE NULL END AS PROD_JP_NM_DISP_KIOSK_2 , NVL(thpsp.SALE_UPRC, 0) AS SALE_UPRC , thp.USE_YN FROM TB_HQ_PRODUCT thp , TB_HQ_PRODUCT_INFO thpi , TB_HQ_PRODUCT_SALE_PRICE_V01 thpsp WHERE 1=1 AND thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD = thpi.HQ_OFFICE_CD (+) AND thp.PROD_CD = thpi.PROD_CD (+) AND thp.HQ_OFFICE_CD = thpsp.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND thp.PROD_CD = thpsp.PROD_CD AND thpsp.SALE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMdd')
AND thp.PROD_CD LIKE '%'||#{prodCd}||'%' --상품코드
AND thp.PROD_NM LIKE '%'||#{prodNm}||'%' --상품명
AND thp.PROD_CLASS_CD IN ( SELECT PROD_CLASS_CD FROM TB_HQ_PRODUCT_CLASS WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} START WITH PROD_CLASS_CD = #{prodClassCd} AND HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} CONNECT BY PRIOR PROD_CLASS_CD = P_PROD_CLASS_CD AND HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} )
AND thp.USE_YN = #{useYn} --사용여부
-- 선택한 상품브랜드가 없을 때('전체' 일때), 사용자 관리브랜드에 속한 정보만 조회 AND thp.HQ_BRAND_CD IN
#{item}
AND ( ( ((SELECT COUNT(HQ_BRAND_CD) FROM TB_WB_USER_BRAND WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) != 0) AND (thp.HQ_BRAND_CD IN (SELECT HQ_BRAND_CD FROM TB_WB_USER_BRAND WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})) ) OR ( ((SELECT COUNT(HQ_BRAND_CD) FROM TB_WB_USER_BRAND WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) = 0) AND 1=1 ) ) ORDER BY thp.PROD_CD ASC
